plan: The optimal strategy is to bid just above what I believe the third-highest bid will be, maximizing my profit if I win. Since values are uniformly distributed, the expected third-highest bid is around $16.33 (the average of the distribution minus one standard deviation). To ensure winning with minimal cost, I will bid slightly above this expected value.

Given my value of $18, I should bid slightly below this value to maximize profit while ensuring a competitive offer. Rational bidders will likely bid close to their values, so I aim to bid just below mine to win if others have lower values. I will bid $17.9, as it maximizes potential profit if I win and minimizes loss risk if I lose.

Given my value of $25, I should bid slightly below it to maximize my profit if I win, while ensuring I don't overpay. Since the prize value is uniformly distributed, a bid slightly below my value (e.g., $24.9) minimizes the chance of overbidding and maximizes potential profit.
